payload.title: Catalog read robustness and write amplification (lab single-classifier C4)
payload.description: Typed cause for PayloadUnavailable/JournalUnavailable plus one transient S3 GET retry; find and stop the whole-snapshot rewrite storm (8,550 blobs / 11.19 GB since 2026-10-21T01Z, 1,000-2,172 commits/hour). Acceptance: transient-error retry spec; typed cause for permanent failure; measured commit-rate baseline before/after. Never retry writes or conditional puts.
